reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26197000 (2026-10-15T09:24:59Z), asset()=0x8292bb45bf1ee4d140127049757c2e0ff06317ed; totalAssets=454517126800634570805195842, idle underlying=22599096677134371116903586, sole adapter realAssets=431918030123500199688292256, in underlying smallest units. Idle plus adapter assets reconcile exactly to totalAssets, and the sum of all 10 expectedSupplyAssets values exactly equals adapter realAssets. All 10 positions have zero borrow shares and zero posted collateral. The largest borrower collateral exposures are kBTC (54.0610% of vault NAV), weETH (21.4082%) and USDe (13.6074%); cbBTC, FXRP, syrupUSDC and wstETH account for the remaining substantive lending positions. WBTC, PT-sUSDE-13AUG2026 and WETH each retain only 1 wei of lender assets. Allocations change under curator controls; borrower collateral is distinct from the underlying deposited token. The parent link denotes denomination and inherited token risk, not ownership of the parent issuer reserves.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Immediate lender positions are held in contracts and intentionally reused as loans. No whole-book claim of exclusively on-chain ultimate collateral custody is made. Parent issuer custody remains inherited; underlying collateral legal/custody layers and recoveries are unresolved. June 2026 Sentora terms section 4.3 describes non-custodial vault configurations; section 21.4 specifies BVI governing law and arbitration. This is an issuer legal statement, not evidence of borrower collateral segregation or removal of observed curator powers. Lending deployment is intentional strategy reuse; it does not establish custodians' contractual rights to repledge collateral, which remain unknown.
